title: A Temporal Network Approach to Paranoia: A Pilot Study
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subject network
limitations: - Small sample size (n = 23); - Low ESM compliance leading to potential selection bias; - Data did not meet normality assumptions; - Network models are low dimensional (only 5 nodes); - No formal statistical tests for centrality comparisons; - No tools available to assess robustness of temporal network estimates.
notes: The study was part of a larger randomized controlled trial registered at ClinicalTrials.gov. The ESM data was collected using a combination of PACO APP and Qualtrics platforms. The authors state that the data, ESM items, and R code are publicly available via the Open Science Framework (OSF) at https://osf.io/7tk4b/. The study is a pilot study with a small sample size, which limits generalizability.
